Mike: Heads up — seeing a ~12% throughput regression on Mixtral-8B after we enabled RoPE scale=1.5 in prod. Root ts: 1823456789
Sophia: Can you drop the perf counters + kernel trace? which op fell back?
Mike: profile snippet from perf trace:
```
[2026-03-16 14:02:11] kernel_select: chosen=matmul_fp16_fused (fastpath)
[2026-03-16 14:02:11] kernel_fallback: chosen=sgemm_fp32 (slowpath) reason=kv_dim % 64 != 0
tokens/s: 48,200 -> 42,300
p50 latency: 78ms -> 88ms
GPU SM util: 84% -> 63%
memcpy spikes on paged-kv: +18%
```
perf-bot: bench job 2026-03-16T14:05 (mixtral-8b, rope 1.5) uploaded: s3://bench/mixtral/rope-1.5/2026-03-16
Olivia: We rolled paged KV layout yesterday (interleaved slot tiling). Could fragmentation + alignment be forcing fp32 paths?
Dan: Yep. The tiled/paged layout scatters kv entries across pages; when kv_dim (heads * head_dim) misaligns with warp/L2 tile (64), some microkernels aren't usable -> fallback.
Mike: Current config: num_key_value_heads=32, head_dim=64 -> kv_dim=2048 which is ok, but Mixtral variant uses head_dim=56 (legacy model import) -> kv_dim=1792 -> 1792 % 64 = 0 actually, but we still see fallbacks for odd packing on paged pages.
Sophia: Interesting — probably a stride issue from interleaving. Have we profiled contiguous vs interleaved layouts?
Olivia: Ran quick local: contiguous layout + kv_heads=32 => matmul_fp16_fused used consistently, tokens/s +11%.
Dan: But contiguous raises peak memory for KV by ~6% on 32GB cards, which breaks some Dedicated nodes.
Mike: Experiment notes I pushed:
```
run_bench --model mixtral-8b --rope-scale 1.5 \n  --kv-layout paged_interleaved --kv-heads 32 --batching bucket
# tokens/s: 42.3k, p50 88ms
run_bench --model mixtral-8b --rope-scale 1.5 \n  --kv-layout contiguous --kv-heads 32 --batching bucket
# tokens/s: 46.9k, p50 79ms
run_bench --model mixtral-8b --rope-scale 1.5 \n  --kv-layout paged_interleaved --kv-heads 16 --batching bucket
# tokens/s: 44.1k, p50 82ms (less fallback)
```
Sophia: So reducing num_key_value_heads to 16 improved perf on paged layout. That implies kernel selects better when kv_dim changes.
perf-bot: microkernel registry: prefers kernels when (kv_dim % tile_sz == 0) AND (page_stride % warp_align == 0).
Olivia: RoPE scaling could change rollout of KV lengths because of different attention schedule? Not directly, but it forced a codepath with extra rotmat precompute that changed batch padding distribution.
Dan: Also batching heuristics: current dynamic batching pads to max(seq) in batch; when rope scaling increases effective context usage, seq distribution widens -> we pack fewer items per batch -> underutilized SMs.
Mike: Proposed short fixes:
- revert paged_interleaved on problematic nodes -> contiguous for Mixtral-variants
- add kv_dim alignment shim in model importer: pad head_dim to next multiple of 8 (cheap) and mark as virtual padding
- tuning: lower num_key_value_heads to 16 for Mixtral-8B until importer fix
- batching: add bucketed pad-to-quantum (pad to 8/16 token multiples) to improve packing
Sophia: I like the importer shim; virtual padding avoids model weight change. Any numerical diff concerns?
Olivia: Padding head dims inside KV tensors is zero-filled; no numerical effect if we mask properly. We should add unit tests to ensure logits unaffected beyond rounding.
Dan: I'll instrument profiler to emit kernel choice + page fragmentation metric per request (new trace tag: kv_layout_frag).
Mike: Can we add a quick kernel patch to let fp16 kernel accept stride mismatches up to 128 bytes? That'd be higher risk.
Sophia: Risky; prefer importer shim + layout switch first. If still bad, we can micropatch kernel with safety checks.
perf-bot: created issue INF-1248 "Mixtral: RoPE + paged KV -> kernel fallback + throughput regression" assigned to eng-runtime
Mike: Action items: Dan -> add kv_layout_frag trace + perf counter (EOD), Olivia -> create canary rollout to contiguous for 10% hosts (tomorrow AM), Sophia -> spec importer shim PR, Mike -> prepare rollback plan for paged KV deploy.
Olivia: Quick note: also check Qwen variants; they have head_dim 64 but different RoPE handling — might be unaffected but verify.
Dan: I'll run multi-model sweep (Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen) with kv_heads {8,16,32} and layout {contiguous,paged_interleaved} and post CSV.
Mike: Thanks — please paste results back here. If contiguous fixes for Mixtral only, we should still prefer shim to get paged gains for memory in Dedicated.
Olivia: Also add a short e2e perf test in our CI that asserts tokens/s not down >5% vs baseline for major model families after infra changes.
Sophia: Agree. I'll open PR for the bucketed batching + pad quantum (8 tokens) as well.
Mike: :thumbsup: Let's reconvene after the sweep. (reaction: :eyes:)
